purpose: Falsify necessity of handcrafted balanced-partition feature in KNOW17 by fitting raw four source property bits+action to utility determined only after witnessed synthetic counterfactual outcomes.
research_owner: Independent Yggdrasil knowledge contributor on PR1327; Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work PR1278 sole model coordinator

predecessor.gap: KNOW17 native utility input was hand-computed balanced candidate split bit

fixture.probe_patterns: all 16 four-property binary combinations, permuted by seed
fixture.source_id: salted role-independent opaque numeric Q/P/Q ids, no phase or outcome leakage
fixture.source_image: read-only full 21,343,681 historical TRAIN facts plus independent synthetic candidate overlay

train.source_only_query_features: four raw binary property bits (0..15) and proposed binary action, not balanced partition, entropy, expected reduction or role ID
train.training_witnesses: for each of 16 probe source patterns x both actions x each of four separate counterfactual hidden-role worlds, query the oracle and record actual binary action outcome; the learner never sees hidden role identities
train.teacher_feedback_rule: AFTER all four witnessed outcomes of the same raw query, binary useful label = 1 only when exactly two outcomes are zero and two are one; else zero. No source-only fabricated outcome and no analytic balanced feature fed to learner
train.native_original_class: NativeContextAccumulator(context_bits=4).stage_update(address=0, utility_rows, source_sha256, max_degree=4) using original source and two batches of 32 distinct (pattern,action,label) rows
train.retention: Check 32 old query predictions A before B, after B and independent cold restore all exact, 0 old drift

controls: same 256 witnessed outcomes: independently fully trained exact symbolic utility table
same 256 witnessed outcomes: conventional fully fitted depth-5 binary classification tree on raw four-bit pattern and action
same 256 witnessed outcomes: NativeContextBasis full refit from A+B rows
analytic role-partition oracle ceiling with same two-query test budget
random two queries per held hidden world

held.required_roles_identified: 12/12 native and equal strong policies; random/passive actual measured, never guessed
held.query_choice: maximize frozen learned utility prediction on raw candidate public four-bit source values and action, no precomputed balanced bit; candidate posterior filtering after witnessed outcome remains analytic and identical across controls
held.input_aliasing: held source graph identical for four roles per seed; seed-salted opaque ids; no private role in query-scoring
held.generalization_limit: held seed/entity identities new but finite all-16 raw feature patterns are repeated; NOT unseen feature combinations or open-world causal transfer

negative_controls: untrained model must abstain on insufficient support
degree-three GF2 class must be unable to fit complete raw-bit utility due required degree-four action interaction
source-only cannot identify which of four roles
engineering_gate: Original 4-bit native degree4 learned utility has exact held role selection 12/12 under same two-action budget as fully fitted controls, 0/32 old forecast changes, full cold restore, 256 actual synthetic training action witnesses, exact source SHA, six-job full final Linux+Windows+original archived compatibility
scientific_gate: native must improve held causal discovery >0.01 over each fully trained same-information exact symbolic, tree and full-native-refit under independent original-world first-use and whole-process cost; ties mandate DEV_NO_GO_STRONGEST_CONTROL_TIE
failure_policy: One frozen run, retain negatives, no post-result seed/threshold changes; engineering fixture defects may be corrected without changing frozen experiment
governance: No native canonical checkpoint changes, merge, owner training, fresh original-world first-use, scheduler/controller, paid API, deployment, full index dumps.
